name: Pocket Deck Slim
units: deck units: body = 1600 x 800 (2:1). scale s = deckWidthPx / 1600.
stack: LCD Frame (rect lcd, UICorner lcdRadius * s, #0C0D10 leaning 10% to the plate's deep colour; ClipsDescendants)

letters.A: BuilderSans ExtraBold, size = 0.46 * diameter, colour = faceplate ink

press: swap base and gloss to the -pressed sprites (cap drops by 7% of its diameter, lower edge collapses); the letter moves down the same amount. 60 ms down, 100 ms up.

hitTargets.dpad: four 96 x 96 unit quadrant buttons, never below 44 px each
hitTargets.shoulders: 220 x 56 units each, extending down over the band

band-9slice.png.note: same art as band.png for decks that are not exactly 2:1

plate-overlay.png.note: hardware detail over any faceplate: lip, shade, gloss, glass recess, wells, screws, seed speaker, LED socket. Do not tint.

glass-glare.png.note: above all LCD content, ImageTransparency 0; hide under Reduced Effects if it hurts contrast

button-base.png.note: A and B both use this. Rect = centre +- diameter/2, height = diameter * 1.07 (the lower edge hangs below). Base: tint with the accent (A) or #3A3E47 (B). Gloss: never tinted.

button-base-pressed.png.note: A and B both use this. Rect = centre +- diameter/2, height = diameter * 1.07 (the lower edge hangs below). Base: tint with the accent (A) or #3A3E47 (B). Gloss: never tinted.

button-gloss.png.note: A and B both use this. Rect = centre +- diameter/2, height = diameter * 1.07 (the lower edge hangs below). Base: tint with the accent (A) or #3A3E47 (B). Gloss: never tinted.

button-gloss-pressed.png.note: A and B both use this. Rect = centre +- diameter/2, height = diameter * 1.07 (the lower edge hangs below). Base: tint with the accent (A) or #3A3E47 (B). Gloss: never tinted.

dpad-press.png.note: UP wedge; set Rotation 90 / 180 / 270 for right / down / left; visible only while held

shoulder.png.note: same sprite for L and R (rects shoulderL and shoulderR); sits behind the band

wordmark.png.note: 41 x 16 cells at 8 px. Engraved look: one copy offset (+1.6, +2) units in the opposite tone (white 30% under a dark engrave, black 45% under a light one), then the main copy on top.
